First-person cat simulator Catlateral Damage has just been released.

My cat does this! It's like he is testing me.

"Human, what is this cup doing to close to the ledge, YOU FAIL! (cup spills every where). We will try again tomorrow." - Myles

I think cats in general have an unhealthy obsession with the tiny measurements between valuable things and the edges of surfaces they rest upon. It's like they lay there all day in agonistic thought thinking "But the glass was only 3cm away from the edge! 3cm! Oh god!"

Overall I loved the game. But here's my thoughts.

Its a fun game that throws you into the perspective and size of a cat. You bat things with your paws, push things with your paws, and even open or interact with items like a sink, oven, or fridge. What isYour goal?

to knock everything off of the various shelves, counters, tables and any other surface you find

But it doesn't just end with that simple gameplay. A few random events like moon gravity, a few chases, and powerups.

Now powerups are important in this game, as they dev made them spawn often. Mostly through interactions with sparking objects. You can unlock speed, jump, and swatting upgrades, or temporary boosts. You can even get some catnip that sends you on a nice, but powerful trip (plus some perks you can find out yourself)

With the addition of over 200 collectable photos, 30+ unlockable cats, and it even tracks the amount of crap you've broken or thrown off(by item too!). This game is fun. Very very fun. Goat Simulator for the first time fun. But with the differences, the gameplay wasn't just some stupid rehashing of goat simulator.

But rather a game that puts you in a unique mindset, the one of an asshole cat who loves breaking everything before their owner gets home.
The trailer is pretty cringey but it still seems appropriate considering the game is really funny and lighthearted.
